files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A multi-step form header: the steps with the current one marked (aria-current step), and the current step's
  text with back and next buttons. Axes: layout (horizontal, vertical), marker (number, icon), summary (show,
  hide).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";

export type StepperProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  steps: Step[];
  current?: number;
  stepLabel: string;
  back: string;
  next: string;
  layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
  marker?: "number" | "icon";
  summary?: "show" | "hide";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import IconBadge from "../compose/IconBadge.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  steps,
  current = 2,
  stepLabel,
  back,
  next,
  layout = "horizontal",
  marker = "number",
  summary = "show",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<StepperProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" measure="3xl" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Stack v-if="((steps?.length ?? 0) > 0)" gap="6" align="stretch" data-slot="stepper">
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ tpl(stepLabel, current, (steps?.length ?? 0)) }}
      </Text>
      <List
        tag="ol"
        :class="cn(
          'm-0 flex list-none gap-4 p-0',
          (((layout as string) === 'vertical') ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-col sm:flex-row')
        )"
        data-slot="items"
      >
        <ListItem v-for="(s, i) in steps" :key="s.id"
          class="flex flex-1 items-center gap-4"
          :aria-current="(((i + 1) === current) ? 'step' : undefined)"
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <IconBadge
            :variant="(((i + 1) < (current + 1)) ? 'primary' : 'outline')"
            size="sm"
            :class="(((i + 1) < (current + 1)) ? 'text-sm' : 'text-sm text-muted-foreground')"
          >
            <LucideIcon v-if="((marker as string) === 'icon')" :name="s.icon" :size="16" />
            <Inline v-else class="text-sm font-bold">
              {{ ((i + 1) == null ? undefined : String((i + 1))) }}
            </Inline>
          </IconBadge>
          <Text size="sm" :weight="(((i + 1) === current) ? 'bold' : 'semibold')">
            {{ s.title }}
          </Text>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
      <template v-if="((summary as string) === 'show')">
        <template v-for="(s, i) in steps" :key="s.id">
          <Stack
            v-if="((i + 1) === current)"
            gap="2"
            class="rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border"
            data-slot="step-summary"
          >
            <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
              {{ s.title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ s.text }}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="2" class="pt-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button">
                {{ back }}
              </Button>
              <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button">
                {{ next }}
              </Button>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        </template>
      </template>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
